## Objective
A clear statement of the proposed architectural change.

## Architecture Impact
- Which layers are impacted (UI / API / Service / Repository)?
- Does this require introducing new repositories or refactoring boundaries?
- How will the SMRITI Architecture Guard rules be enforced?

## Design Decisions
Detail the proposed architectural patterns and references to existing SMRITI design systems.

## Risks & Mitigation
Identify potential risks (e.g., performance impact, data lock contention) and mitigation strategies.
